programme.name: Human Performance and AI in Sports Analytics Minor

unit_statements_verbatim: The program requires at least 18 units.

notes.text: This interdisciplinary program prepares students to apply AI, data science, as well as human and sport performance principles to improve athletic outcomes and reduce risk of injuries. With this minor, students are able to generate data-driven insights for key stakeholders throughout the sports industry ecosystem, thereby advancing human and athletic performance. With AI and monetization strategies reshaping the sports landscape, the program positions students to engage critically and creatively with emerging technologies and economic models. The program requires at least 18 units.
